Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused; submissions of the learned counsel for the parties noted above; finding force in the submissions made by the learned counsel for the applicant; keeping view the uncertainty regarding conclusion of trial; one sided investigation by police, ignoring the case of accused side; applicant being under-trial having fundamental right to speedy trial; larger mandate of the Article 21 of the Constitution of India;
considering the dictum of Apex Court in the recent judgment dated 11.07.2022 of the Apex Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil vs. C.B.I., passed in S.L.P (Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021; considering 5-6 times overcrowding in jails over and above their capacity by the under trials and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__arguments:
4. Learned counsel for applicant submits that order impugned in present application is manifestly illegal and without jurisdiction.
6. Learned counsel for applicant submits that justice should not only be done but should also seen to be done.

opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__facts: Accordingly accused/applicant filed an application dated 13.12.2022 before Court below praying therein that the ossification test of the prosecutrix be got conducted to ascertain her correct age.
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__ANALYSIS:
There is no corroborative material either in respect of the date of birth of the prosecutrix.
There is nothing on record as to on what basis the date of birth of prosecutrix was recorded as 15.10.2000.
Thereafter, the Principal of the institution,
where the prosecutrix had studied for the first time was also examined as a Court witness.
The same clearly speaks of the malacious conduct of the applicant.
8. Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State and upon perusal of record, this Court finds that the only evidence regarding the age of prosecutrix which has come on record of aforementioned Sessions Trial (POCSO case) is the class Vth certificate of the prosecutrix,
wherein her date of birth is recorded as 15.10.2000.
It is a well accepted facet of the principles of natural justice that justice should not only be done but also seen to be done.
The prayer made by accused applicant was to conclude the proceedings in a free and fair manner.
An accused has also the right to face trial and he cannot be denied the right to plead his defence in the light of additional material which can be considered only during the course of trial.
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__decision:
In view of above, this Court finds that interest of justice shall be served, in case, the ossification test of the prosecutrix is got conducted to determine her age before deciding the guilt of accused-applicant.
10.
